evidence.claim: A DSS inflates vault totalAssets by depositing and queuing a redeem before requestSlashing, so earmarkedStakes is computed on inflated totalAssets; after the DSS withdraws its own funds, finalizeSlashing's Math.min clamp in Vault.slashAssets slashes the entire remaining vault balance, exceeding maxSlashablePercentageWad.
evidence.support_reason: SlasherLib.fetchEarmarkedStakes (SlasherLib.sol:86-90) computes earmarkedStakes from live totalAssets() at request time; Vault.slashAssets (Vault.sol:198) clamps to Math.min(totalAssets(), totalAssetsToSlash) at finalize time, so a shrunk vault is slashed to zero. Nothing re-validates the earmark against the post-withdrawal balance, and startRedeem/finishRedeem (Vault.sol:125-188) are open to any shareholder, so the DSS can inflate then exit.
preconditions: DSS is registered and operator is staked to it in the target vault
DSS holds enough tokens to inflate totalAssets above the honest balance
DSS queues a redeem at least MIN_WITHDRAWAL_DELAY before requestSlashing so it can finishRedeem inside the veto window
veto committee does not cancel the inflated request

missing_evidence.item: Executed reproduction (or concrete trace) showing the DSS's own redeem shares are excluded from the slashed amount and that the clamp actually fires with the stated numbers
missing_evidence.why: The PoC block is unexecuted and depends on helper fixtures (stake_vaults_to_dss, dss, operator, vaults) not in the audited source; the claim's core step (earmark > post-withdraw totalAssets, clamp to full balance) is asserted, not demonstrated. Without a verified run the reproduction does not support this particular claim.
missing_evidence.resolves_when: A runnable test against the audited commit (or a step-by-step trace with real balances) shows earmarkedStakes > totalAssets at finalize and the vault balance going to zero.

missing_evidence.item: Confirmation that the DSS's queued-redeem shares still count in totalAssets() at requestSlashing time
missing_evidence.why: The inflation depends on startRedeem not reducing totalAssets (shares are held by the vault, Vault.sol:146). If totalAssets excluded queued shares the path would not inflate the earmark; the report asserts this but the audited source alone does not settle the ERC4626 accounting of vault-held shares.
missing_evidence.resolves_when: A test or trace shows totalAssets() including the DSS's queued shares at requestSlashing, or the report shows an alternative inflation route.

missing_evidence.item: Whether the veto committee's ability to cancel (Core.cancelSlashing, Core.sol:235-243) is a policy-level mitigation that defeats the severity
missing_evidence.why: The report itself concedes the veto committee could cancel; this affects severity judgment but not whether the path is reachable, so it does not undermine the supported claim.
